title: Art. 9.5 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 9 - Passenger Data Exchange Systems, A. General, 9.5
content: Contracting States shall not require aircraft operators to provide non- standard data elements as part of API, iAPI and/or PNR provisions.
